snippet.title: Dandelion Void - Wishlist Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist now on Steam!
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3582810?utm_source=yt_wl_trailer

Explore the jungle choked corridors of a derelict ark, adrift between the stars. Construct shelters and loot powerful artifacts from the skeletal remains of your starfaring ancestors. But never let your guard down, because the jungle is alive and hostile…
